glosses: sich nicht auf einen Menschen beziehend, nicht zu einem Menschen gehörig, nicht von einem Menschen stammend

examples.text: Das Blut stammt definitiv von einem nichtmenschlichen Lebewesen.

glosses: Not human; not of the human race.

examples.text: Other examples of nonhuman self-domestication in the wild exist—for instance, the Zanzibar red colobus monkey diverged from the mainland African red colobus in similar ways during its island isolation—but bonobos are the closest and most relevant to us.

Much, perhaps most, Minecraft fiction follows the robinsonade template, emphasizing the day-to-day life of a character, including nonhuman characters, striving to survive and thrive in a recognizably Minecraftian world by utilizing its resources.

glosses: A creature or thing that is not human.

examples.text: The dialectical obverse of this use of opium is the fear that opium will turn humans into nonhumans or antihumans.
